audit_title: 10% Stratified Clinical Audit of Gemma 4 Distilled Morphological Descriptors

audit_protocol.sampling_method: Stratified random sampling across feline and canine breeds

reference_standards.canine: American Kennel Club (AKC) & Fédération Cynologique Internationale (FCI)
reference_standards.feline: Cat Fanciers' Association (CFA) & The International Cat Association (TICA)

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Slender, elegant, and muscular frame with a graceful gait. The tail is long and tapering.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurately captures the distinctive tubular, svelte feline body geometry and tapering tail.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Athletic and highly muscular build; sleek profile with a proportionate, balanced stance.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Correctly reflects robust feral-derived muscularity without stocky heaviness.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Deeply set, exhibiting a medium to dark amber or brown hue; the shape is generally rounded.
audit_items.reference_standard: UKC / AKC FSS American Bulldog Standard
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurate orbital placement, rounded eye aperture, and permitted pigmentation range.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Moderately long muzzle with a strong, well-defined skull structure. Ears are broad, drop close to head.
audit_items.reference_standard: AKC / FCI German Shorthaired Pointer Standard
audit_items.clinical_notes: Proper cranial-to-muzzle proportions and typical pendulous drop-ear conformation.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: A dense, medium-to-long double coat. The texture is soft and silky, characterized by distinct feathering on the ears, chest, and legs.
audit_items.reference_standard: AKC / FCI English Cocker Spaniel Standard
audit_items.clinical_notes: Correctly specifies silky coat texture and classic anatomical feathering locations.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Extremely short, fine-grained pile providing a smooth texture; the coat exhibits a shimmering gloss.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Faithfully captures the unique lustrous sheen of Mau coat pile.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Rounded, well-proportioned cranium with a medium muzzle; ears are erect, triangular with slightly rounded tips.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurately represents the modified rounded skull profile characteristic of the breed.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Large, expressive, and almond-shaped; typically vivid golden amber or deep green.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Matches breed criteria for large oval-to-almond eye aperture and diagnostic green/gold hues.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Compact, muscular, and sturdy build; low-slung torso with visible muscle definition and a broad chest.
audit_items.reference_standard: AKC / FCI Staffordshire Bull Terrier Standard
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurately identifies dense musculature, compact stature, and low center of gravity.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: The unique, cool, silvery-blue sheen of the coat pile, which provides a shimmering visual distinction.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Clinical hallmark: silver tipping on plush double coat producing the characteristic frosted glow.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: A short, dense double coat provides a smooth visual texture. Coloration is typically tri-color or bi-color patches.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurate weather-resistant hound coat description and common hound saddle patterns.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Deeply set, dark brown eyes characterized by an alert and intelligent expression under prominent brows.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Captures the deep-set piercing almond eye gaze shaded by bushy eyebrows.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Compact, muscular build with a graceful carriage; the torso is finely proportioned with a high-stepping stance.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Identifies the proud, compact carriage and characteristic hackney-like gait anatomy.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Extremely muscular and heavily boned frame; possesses a deep chest cavity indicating immense power.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Correctly emphasizes heavy bone density and prominent thoracic depth.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Short, dense, and smooth double coat; color patterns are variable but often include solid white or pied patches.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurate coat density and predominant white/pied coloration.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: The build is sturdy and mesomorphic, possessing a moderate frame. The torso is well-sprung with a level topline.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurate hound thoracic spring of ribs and level dorsal topline.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: Sleek, well-chiseled wedge shape; ears are proportionate, triangular, and set high to maintain an alert silhouette.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Accurate medium-modified wedge skull and alert, broad-based ear carriage.

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: The combination of the short, dense coat texture and the unique, shimmering quality of the coat across a dorsal spine.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Marginal omission: While the sheen and dorsal line are accurate, it omits explicit mention of naturally occurring random spots (the primary defining CFA hallmark).

audit_items.distilled_descriptor: The unique combination of the heavily wrinkled facial topography and the tightly curled tail over hip.
audit_items.clinical_notes: Clinical diagnostic traits: deep facial wrinkling and tightly curled tail.

audit_summary.conclusion: Autonomous distillation via Gemma 4 E4B provides high diagnostic precision (94.7% compliance), confirming clinical suitability for concept bottleneck projection.
